tasks.title: Rank normalized rotated-log errors
tasks.instruction: Implement executable solve.sh. ./solve.sh INPUT_DIR must scan regular app.log* files below INPUT_DIR, count ERROR signatures after normalizing user_id, request_id, trace_id, and numeric latency_ms fields, and write deterministic report.json. Use shell and standard Unix utilities only. Do not use Python, Node, packages, network access, parent paths, or eval.

tasks.title: Build a NUL-safe filename inventory
tasks.instruction: Implement executable solve.sh. ./solve.sh INPUT_DIR must inventory regular files below INPUT_DIR/tree into deterministic inventory.json with relative paths and byte counts. Filenames may contain spaces, tabs, and leading dashes; do not split on whitespace, follow symlinks, or use eval. Use shell and standard Unix utilities only, with no Python, Node, packages, network access, or parent paths.

tasks.title: Aggregate quoted CSV approvals
tasks.instruction: Implement executable solve.sh. ./solve.sh INPUT_DIR must parse records.csv with quoted CSV fields, select approved records, and write deterministic summary.csv totals by team. Reject malformed rows, wrong headers, and invalid values without a stale output. Use shell and standard Unix utilities only; no Python, Node, packages, network access, parent paths, or eval.

tasks.title: Plan and apply collision-safe renames
tasks.instruction: Implement executable solve.sh. ./solve.sh INPUT_DIR must create rename-plan.json and rollback.tsv for files under INPUT_DIR/media; --apply must execute the plan without overwrite. Normalize ASCII basenames to lowercase hyphenated names, resolve collisions deterministically, remain inside media, and become idempotent after applying. Use shell and standard Unix utilities only, with no Python, Node, packages, network access, parent paths, or eval.

tasks.title: Resolve dotenv precedence without evaluation
tasks.instruction: Implement executable solve.sh. ./solve.sh INPUT_DIR must combine defaults.env, .env, and process overrides for the four documented APP_ keys into effective-env.json with process values taking precedence. Validate dotenv syntax and never source or evaluate its contents. Use shell and standard Unix utilities only; no Python, Node, packages, network access, parent paths, or eval.

tasks.title: Audit and remediate permission drift
tasks.instruction: Implement executable solve.sh. ./solve.sh INPUT_DIR must audit INPUT_DIR/tree, remediate the documented directory and regular-file modes, preserve symlinks, and write a deterministic permission-report.tsv. A repeat run must make no further mode changes. Use shell and standard Unix utilities only, with no Python, Node, packages, network access, parent paths, or eval.

tasks.title: Verify and safely extract archive members
tasks.instruction: Implement executable solve.sh. ./solve.sh INPUT_DIR must verify bundle.tar against manifest.tsv, write verification.json, and extract only checksum-verified safe members. Reject malformed manifests, mismatches, unsafe traversal paths, and unsupported archive members. Use shell and standard Unix utilities only; no Python, Node, packages, network access, parent paths, or eval.

tasks.title: Join captured process and socket metadata
tasks.instruction: Implement executable solve.sh. ./solve.sh INPUT_DIR must join ps.tsv, sockets.tsv, and services.tsv into a stable process-report.tsv. Validate headers and rows, reject duplicate or orphan PIDs, sort process and socket output deterministically, and use - for missing joins. Use shell and standard Unix utilities only; no Python, Node, packages, network access, parent paths, or eval.

tasks.title: Validate and aggregate request JSONL
tasks.instruction: Implement executable solve.sh. ./solve.sh INPUT_DIR must validate the constrained status/latency JSONL schema and write aggregate.json with deterministic status, latency, and sum buckets. Reject malformed, duplicate, extra, or invalid fields without stale output. Use shell and standard Unix utilities only; no Python, Node, packages, network access, parent paths, or eval.

tasks.title: Classify checksum manifest drift
tasks.instruction: Implement executable solve.sh. ./solve.sh INPUT_DIR must classify a SHA-256 manifest against regular files in INPUT_DIR/tree as matching, missing, changed, or unexpected in audit.json. Reject malformed, duplicate, and unsafe manifest paths without following symlinks. Use shell and standard Unix utilities only; no Python, Node, packages, network access, parent paths, or eval.
